summary: This March 13 Danny Haiphong interview is already public Chokepoint and Eschatology evidence: it gives the no-exit dollar-war formulation before the March 20 and March 24 escalation sources, while also producing dated forecast-ledger candidates around ground invasion, draft politics, oil shock, deindustrialization, remilitarization, and eschatological acceleration.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: The public read already links hubris/desperation, BRICS-plus dollar-dumping pressure, missing logistics/manufacturing capacity, and the dollar losing its buyers to the no-exit war anchor.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The existing Chokepoint child page uses this source to define no-exit war: victory requires ground, draft, logistics, and manufacturing capacity the empire lacks, while retreat threatens the protection story that makes allies host bases and buy debt.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: The public read already links the alignment of religious extremists and transnational capital, short-term pain for long-term gain, and chaos as a buying opportunity to the Eschatology acceleration anchor.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The existing Eschatology page already preserves the boundary: sacred acceleration and capital's asset-timing logic converge without becoming the same motive.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Keep this interview as the March 13 no-exit formulation that precedes the March 20 war-gets-own-logic source and the March 24 escalation-ladder source: Jiang moves from different political realities and pressure-point warfare into a dollar-war trap where withdrawal would make alliance protection, Treasury buying, and Gulf basing look false.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Chokepoint owns this source when the active mechanism is access control, Gulf infrastructure, Hormuz, draft/logistics limits, protection credibility, debt buyers, and exit cost. Game Theory owns only the method of playing out the retreat scenario; Power As Alchemy owns the dollar as believed reality when the monetary conversion itself is primary.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use this source as the compact anchor for pressure-point warfare against an empire's nerves: Iran's calibration targets air defenses, airports, banks, data centers, desalination, oil infrastructure, Hormuz, food routes, and GCC political stability rather than matching American shock-and-awe theater.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: This strengthens Chokepoint rather than parent Strategy because the decisive board is not generic war competence; it is the coupled access network of energy, water, food, finance, bases, and alliance belief.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Keep this source as the March 13 acceleration layer: Jiang says the Iran war cannot be explained only geopolitically, then joins end-times interpretation to capital's interest in war, destruction, cheap asset acquisition, water/mining rights, land, and reconstruction profits.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Eschatology owns the role-script that can make collapse desirable. Chokepoint owns the war architecture being accelerated; Imperial Retrenchment owns fortress-resource strategy; Secret Society only receives this material when hidden coordination rather than public eschatological logic is active.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use this source as a dated forecast-audit checkpoint after Danny explicitly asks whether Jiang's Iran-war prediction is playing out: record the ground-invasion/draft forecast, post-retreat GCC/Hormuz/Treasury chain, five-to-ten-year deindustrialization/remilitarization/mercantilism forecast, oil-shock restrictions, and spiritual-awakening survival counsel as comparison material before any ledger promotion.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Prediction owns dated testability and later audit. Chokepoint owns the no-exit mechanism; Eschatology owns sacred acceleration; Human Heart or Free Will may receive the final spiritual counsel only when the active mechanism is moral survival rather than forecast.

chronology_notes.note: The source is dated 2026-03-13 and should be treated as the public no-exit formulation after the March 9 live-war bridge and before the March 20 war-gets-own-logic and March 24 escalation-ladder intensifications.

Jiang explicitly frames the post-empire trends as a five-to-ten-year consequence of the Iran war puncturing the aura of American inevitability: deindustrialization/deurbanization, remilitarization through nationalism or theocracy, and mercantile trade blocs.

The energy-shock answer moves across horizons: short-term work restrictions and rationing, medium-term unrest and nationalism, long-term social restructuring and spiritual response. Do not collapse those into one undated apocalypse claim.
